title: Molar Specific Heats (C_V, C_P)
theory:
Monatomic: $C_V = \frac{3}{2}R$, $C_P = \frac{5}{2}R$; Mayer: $C_P = C_V + R$; $\gamma = C_P/C_V = \frac{5}{3}$. Heats: isochoric $Q = nC_V\Delta T$, isobaric $Q = nC_P\Delta T$. **The PV shortcut:** $nR\Delta T = \Delta(PV)$, hence
$$Q_V = \tfrac{3}{2}\Delta(PV), \qquad Q_P = \tfrac{5}{2}\Delta(PV)$$
— exactly how the cycle problems below are cracked in seconds, with no n and no T.
